KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.

2. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. fupi
   D. nene

3. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

4. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

6. When practising Kuzungumza:Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Kuzungumza:Msamiati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Kuzungumza:Msamiati.

7. When practising asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa., which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   B. Use insults to “practise” asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   C. Copy random text without understanding asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa..

8. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. watoto
   B. kitoto
   C. mato
   D. mitoto

9. When practising huyu na hawa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” huyu na hawa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for huyu na hawa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to huyu na hawa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding huyu na hawa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain asikilize kisa kikisimuliwa. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain wakati uliopo and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
